prompt: A photo-mode capture from a video game that draws its world and its people in two different ways. Every building, street, lamp and sky is crisp 16-bit pixel art: one even pixel grid, a limited palette of thirty-two colours, hard pixel edges. Only the people are painted in muted realism: weathered faces with real skin texture, stubble and tired eyes, 1930s wool coats, flat caps and worn leather, soft brushwork. A tall narrow building cut open like a doll's house at night, seen from across the street, low and to the left, four floors from the top down: an ice blue attic where an old woman in a coat shivers by one candle; a brick red bakery where a crowd in red scarves and a crowd in blue scarves, mixed ages and skin tones, shove each other under a yellow street lamp; an emerald-lit basement where printing presses throw banknotes while gangsters in pinstripe suits play music and a tall skinny mayor in a bowler hat and gold chain dances; an orange furnace at the bottom. A police car roof in the near left corner. Thanks.
